versions.content: Support sub-function 0x06 of UDS service 0x19. Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support sub-function 0x06 of UDS service 0x19 to retrieve extended data records stored for DTCs. Rationale: Provide means to retrieve statistical data. Use Case: Provide system internal statistical information assigned to a certain DTC. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
